newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks marked lower in quiet London.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks marked lower in quiet London.

text.p: Japanese stocks moved lower in quiet London trading on Thursday with the market deprived of any lead from the Dow as Wall Street was closed for the Thanksgiving Day holiday.
The Nikkei 50 index of leading Japanese shares traded here was down 16.88 points at 1,479.81, after the Nikkei 225 in Tokyo fell 309.74 points.
"In Tokyo we saw a long-overdue correction but we weren't too surprised," said one trader at a Japanese brokerage here. "It was a very quiet day obviously with America on holiday."
"We saw a little more profit-taking, a little more position squaring for the end of the month. Tokyo might be interesting tomorrow but I seriously doubt it."
